name: Bounded Concurrency Worker Pool with Graceful Shutdown
description: Refactor an unbounded, leaky goroutine pipeline into a robust bounded worker pool using errgroup, sync.WaitGroup, context cancellation, and error propagation.
instructions: The current Go service in worker.go spawns unbounded goroutines upon every incoming message, leaking memory and causing data races under load. Refactor worker.go to use a bounded worker pool of configurable size N with context.Context cancellation and proper sync.WaitGroup / errgroup synchronization. Ensure all unit and race detector checks pass without goroutine leaks.

deterministicChecks.name: Verify bounded worker pool struct definition
Verify Close or Shutdown method exists

judgeRubrics.rubric: Evaluates prevention of data races, goroutine leaks, and deadlock avoidance.
Evaluates context cancellation propagation and worker error collection.
Evaluates adherence to Go concurrency idioms, channel directionality, and clean package API.
